production_blockers.detail: Only one of three unchanged E0 reboots meets 120 seconds; E0-2=138.328 and E0-3=161.703 seconds. Later successful state/backup checks do not override timing failure.
Early filesystem/service waits, executable page-fault waits, metadata initialization and shared backing-device pressure are observed. No controlled intervention establishes a cause.

Current product head 42ba4f38 includes later full-disk fixes be249/d943; b579 E0 artifact predates them. Open review reports Close SST ENOSPC indefinite retry and QEMU false-PASS risk. E0 performs no disk-fill test.

Later claimed fix a7c07fe1 is absent from E0 artifact; final candidate build, scan and qualification remain pending. No risk acceptance implied. Missing Compose pull_policy can bypass the locally built derivative on absent-cache deployments.

Later claimed scanner/code fix 23dae620 is absent from E0 artifact; previously tracked Snyk GO-2026-5932 and four CodeQL medium findings require final-candidate evidence. No scanner waiver or current resolution inferred. Latest review also observes additional findings in newly vendored Badger; the historical four-row list is not the final inventory.

E0 persistence captures explicitly block Tier-3 historical encrypted-log recovery because supported backups omit those logs. Later custody UX change 42ba4f38 is not in this artifact and does not itself prove log recovery.
E0 is a baseline on b579, not approval of newer fixes or a final production artifact. No readahead experiment result is included.

Current42ba4f38 still forwards fresh content unscanned on daemon errors and caches health for30seconds. A pcre2 image fix and repeated cached EICAR verdicts do not close outage semantics; explicit production behavior and final-artifact tests required.

limitations: Only one approved VM and shared datastore; unrelated host workload was not stopped or controlled.
Sampler starts 21.927s,34.418s,50.162s in E0-1/2/3; earlier per-process I/O and waits are unavailable.
Host/device samples are 20-second averages with phase-boundary overlap; device metrics include unrelated workloads. VM metrics contain missing values and are retained separately, never interpolated.
Host aggregate CPU does not exclude per-core contention; observed zero swap/compression/ballooning does not establish absence outside sampled windows.
Process state/wchan describes sampled main threads, not every thread or continuous duration. Metadata-marker gap is localization, not proof of a particular syscall or storage layer.
Postboot systemd critical-chain includes later Docker namespace mounts; these are not evidence that such mounts blocked early boot.
Signature identities here are version plus file size/mtime, not signature database content hashes.
ClamAV coverage is checked separately on failed cycles because the normal verifier returns on budget failure first; its pass cannot change the budget verdict.
Public JSON contains only allowlisted facts and hashes. Private raw logs, proofs, configurations, addresses and credentials are not embedded or uploaded.
